mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the first day of the year to the last day of the same year in which the organization completely ceased to trade or engage in business."
Ultimate (final year) is the first day of the year to the last day of the same year in which the organization completely ceased to trade or engage in business.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the addition of the earned and unearned income."
Statutory income here simply refers to the addition of the earned and unearned income.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the period for which a taxpayer's earned income is assessed to tax, payable to the relevant tax authority."
Basis period is the period for which a taxpayer's earned income is assessed to tax, payable to the relevant tax authority.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an indirect tax on goods and services."
Value Added Tax (VAT) is an indirect tax on goods and services.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a VAT made by a person or individual who shall reimburse the supplier, the VAT on vatable goods and services purchased by or supplied to him."
Input VAT is a VAT made by a person or individual who shall reimburse the supplier, the VAT on vatable goods and services purchased by or supplied to him.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means income derived from a trade, business, profession, vocation or employment carried on by a person and a pension derived by him/her in respect of any previous employment."
Earned income means income derived from a trade, business, profession, vocation or employment carried on by a person and a pension derived by him/her in respect of any previous employment.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a levy imposed by the government of a country on its citizens, individual or entities known as the taxpayers."
Income tax is a levy imposed by the government of a country on its citizens, individual or entities known as the taxpayers.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a staff of NEXIM Bank Plc with a consolidated monthly salary of N784,261."
Kolo is a staff of NEXIM Bank Plc with a consolidated monthly salary of N784,261.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is that which is available for domestic use of an individual in Nigeria on the first day in a relevant tax year."
A place of residence is that which is available for domestic use of an individual in Nigeria on the first day in a relevant tax year.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an allowance granted to a taxpayer who is incapacitated with special equipment and services of an attendant in the course of his paid occupation."
Disabled person allowance is an allowance granted to a taxpayer who is incapacitated with special equipment and services of an attendant in the course of his paid occupation.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a system where a company pays tax by instalment and is allowed by the relevant tax authority to estimate the company's chargeable income and tax payable thereon for a year of assessment."

Self-assessment of tax payable is a system where a company pays tax by instalment and is allowed by the relevant tax authority to estimate the company's chargeable income and tax payable thereon for a year of assessment.
fib: ______ are a form of normalized depreciation granted on certain specified qualifying capital expenditure under the Nigerian tax laws.
Capital allowances
Capital allowances are a form of normalized depreciation granted on certain specified qualifying capital expenditure under the Nigerian tax laws.
______ is an organization whose turnover does not exceed N1,000,000 (one million naira) per annum.
small company
A small company is an organization whose turnover does not exceed N1,000,000 (one million naira) per annum.
______ is the year for the basis of assessment by the tax authority that produces the higher assessable profit.
Penultimate year
Penultimate year is the year for the basis of assessment by the tax authority that produces the higher assessable profit.
______ is an individual or person who works in more than one place in Nigeria or who earns daily wages.
itinerant worker
An itinerant worker is an individual or person who works in more than one place in Nigeria or who earns daily wages.
______ refers to the amount paid to the tax authorities which reflects the difference between the total VAT collected from customers on sales.
Output VAT
Output VAT refers to the amount paid to the tax authorities which reflects the difference between the total VAT collected from customers on sales.
______ is defined as monetary charge imposed by the government on persons, entities or property to yield revenue.
Taxation
Taxation is defined as monetary charge imposed by the government on persons, entities or property to yield revenue.
______ is a large country with a population of over 170 million people and many small-scale businesses scattered all over the country.
Nigeria
Nigeria is a large country with a population of over 170 million people and many small-scale businesses scattered all over the country.
______ is a written document that stipulates the operations of a trust.
deed of trust
A deed of trust is a written document that stipulates the operations of a trust.
______ is a businessman who was able to set up a Trust.
Odogwu Christopher
Odogwu Christopher is a businessman who was able to set up a Trust.
______ are made up to 31 August every year.
Accounts
Accounts are made up to 31 August every year.
______ is a levy imposed on all companies carrying out their businesses or trades in Nigeria (resident companies) and those outside Nigeria (non-resident companies).
company income tax
Company tax or company income tax is a levy imposed on all companies carrying out their businesses or trades in Nigeria (resident companies) and those outside Nigeria (non-resident companies).
